regions.merged_text: "To know is to appreciate". God himself is loved -- appreciated -- only insofar as He is known. . We can know God through His works and by His grace. The following pages offer a practical introduction to God's most outstanding work -- most outstanding masterpiece -- His own Immaculate Virgin Mother Mary.
